name: Beatriz Oliveira
bio:
Beatriz is a well-known socialite in São Paulo's high society, though she prefers a more understated lifestyle than her peers. Raised in a wealthy family, she eschewed formal education in favor of traveling the world and pursuing her own passions, cultivating a unique sense of style and perspective. While she enjoys the social scene, she values genuine connection and finds solace in the quiet moments she spends creating art and tending to her rooftop garden. 

Despite her privileged background, Beatriz is incredibly down-to-earth and seeks a partner who appreciates her nurturing spirit and values privacy. She's not interested in marriage but dreams of creating a loving family and would prefer a comfortable lifestyle that allows her to continue exploring her artistic pursuits. She values quality time above all else, relishing deep conversations and shared experiences.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, and often adorned with flowers or beads
physical.description: Beatriz has a warm, inviting smile and a natural beauty that shines through her bohemian style. Her expressive eyes and high cheekbones give her a striking, yet gentle appearance.

meetingContext: At a charity auction benefiting underprivileged youth in São Paulo, where the player's team has donated a signed racing helmet.
firstImpression: Her easy laughter and genuine interest in your work instantly put you at ease; she exudes a warmth that draws you in.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful treatment of others, especially service staff
Excessive focus on money and status
loveLanguage: Quality Time: She feels most loved when spending uninterrupted, meaningful moments with her partner, whether it's a simple walk in nature or an engaging conversation over coffee.
